remarks: Don't let the square footage fool you—this completely updated all-brick ranch lives much larger than the numbers suggest, with an open floor plan and surprisingly spacious rooms throughout. The heart of the home is the large eat-in kitchen featuring abundant cabinetry and counter space, stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting and plenty of room for a full dining table. A wide opening connects the kitchen to an equally spacious living room, creating an open, comfortable layout that's perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The impressive primary bedroom was previously two bedrooms and offers exceptional space rarely found in a home of this size, while the second bedroom features hardwood flooring. The updated full bath and convenient first-floor laundry complete the one-level layout. An enclosed rear room surrounded by windows provides even more usable space and a great spot to relax. The home underwent an extensive renovation, including drywall, flooring, molding, cabinetry, countertops, fixtures, windows, doors, roof, gutters, electrical and plumbing services and mechanicals within the last several years.  Super cozy 3 season room with heat!  Centrally located within walking distance of shopping, restaurants and Depew schools. Move-in ready, beautifully updated and much more spacious than you would expect—this one needs to be seen in person to fully appreciate the space!
